definitions.short: Karka (with the article prefix), a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H7173. Qarqa II. קַרְקַע proper name, of a location ( floor ); — with article + ה locative, הַקַּרְקָ֑עָה Josh 15:13 , on extreme southern border of Judah; τὴν κατὰ δυσμὰς Καδης .

occurrences.englishText: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;
